statement: WASM component signature verification is REQUIRED by default in production assembly, with an explicit, loudly-marked development opt-out: an unsigned or unverifiable component is refused typed at install time unless the deployment deliberately opts out, so no production node silently executes unsigned artifacts, and the wasm-signature-policy-required-default scenario is green.

constraints.statement: The development opt-out is an explicit, discoverable policy declaration, not an ambient default; production assembly fails closed without it.
Refusal of unsigned or unverifiable artifacts is a typed install-time error through the canonical Artifact path, never a runtime surprise.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
